lines.en: label day96:
scene newrecall1
: We’re finally free! I felt like today was dragging on forever.
lines.zh: : 我们终于自由啦！我感觉今天漫长得没完没了。

lines.en: : I was {i}this{/i} close to faking a stomach ache so I could go home, Sensei. You better be proud of me for toughing it out.
lines.zh: : 我{i}差点{/i}就要装肚子疼好回家了，Sensei。你该为我硬撑下来感到骄傲才对。

lines.en: : Ami, if you ever want to leave, you can just tell me. I literally do not care at all.
lines.zh: : Ami，你要是想走，直接跟我说就行。我是真的完全不在乎。

lines.en: scene newrecall2
: Well, you should! Like you always used to say, a mind is a terrible thing to waste.
lines.zh: : 可你应该在乎啊！就像你以前常说的，浪费脑子是件可怕的事。

lines.en: scene newrecall3
: Hey, come to think of it...you never really say anything encouraging like that anymore. How come?
lines.zh: : 嘿，说起来……你最近都不怎么再说这种鼓励人的话了。为什么呢？

lines.en: : Have I already peaked as a student in your eyes? Is it all downhill from here?
lines.zh: : 在你眼里，我作为学生已经到顶了吗？从此就一路下坡了？

lines.en: : Maybe it's just the fact that he's changed and is an entirely different person now? That sounds reasonable, doesn't it?
lines.zh: : 也许只是因为他变了，现在完全是另一个人了？听起来挺合理的，不是吗？

lines.en: scene newrecall4
: Oh, hi Maya. Thanks for joining in. You've been so quiet since the last bell rang that I forgot you were even there.
lines.zh: : 哦，嗨，Maya。谢谢你加入进来。放学铃响之后你一直这么安静，我都忘了你还在了。

lines.en: : I apologize for not making my presence more apparent. I’ve been a little distracted all day.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉我没有让自己的存在更明显一点。我一整天都有点心不在焉。

lines.en: scene newrecall5
: And it certainly doesn’t help that {i}he’s{/i} with us for some reason.
lines.zh: : 而且不知为什么{i}他{/i}还跟我们在一起，这当然让情况更糟了。

lines.en: : Hey, I’ve been respectful and haven’t spoken to you at all. The least you can do is refrain from insulting me for a little bit.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我一直很识趣，一句话都没跟你说过。你至少也该稍微忍一忍别骂我吧。

lines.en: : Why? Are the feelings you pretend to have hurt in some way? Would you like me to apply a make-believe bandage to them?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你那些装出来的感情受伤了吗？要不要我给你贴上一张想象出来的创可贴？

lines.en: : Here. Let me reach into my make-believe purse and get one for you.
lines.zh: : 来。让我把手伸进我那个想象出来的包里，给你拿一张。

lines.en: Maya seems abnormally...agitated today- which is surprising given that she’s normally pretty agitated to begin with.
lines.zh: Maya 今天异常地……烦躁——考虑到她平时本来就挺烦躁的，这就很让人意外了。

lines.en: The thing is I {i}really{/i} haven't done anything this time, though. At least not to my knowledge. So this is just completely bizarre to me.
lines.zh: 问题是这次我是{i}真{/i}没干什么啊。至少据我所知没有。所以这对我来说简直莫名其妙。

lines.en: scene newrecall6
: So, uhh...ignoring how cranky you are, is it okay if we stop at the convenience store on the way home?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……先不管你有多暴躁，我们回家路上能顺路去趟便利店吗？

lines.en: : It’s been crazy hot lately and I think I might die if I don’t have a drink in the next few minutes.
lines.zh: : 最近热得要命，要是接下来几分钟内喝不上东西，我觉得我可能会死。

lines.en: : Feel free. I actually have somewhere else I need to be anyway, so I'll be heading back on my own now.
lines.zh: : 随意。反正我本来就另有地方要去，所以现在就自己先回去了。

lines.en: scene newrecall7
: Wait, what? I thought we were studying together tonight.
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？我还以为我们今晚要一起复习呢。

lines.en: : Something came up and I’m not going to be able to make it.
lines.zh: : 出了点事，我去不了了。

lines.en: : What came up? Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了？一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} why you've been in such a bad mood?
lines.zh: : 你心情这么差就是因为{i}那个{/i}吗？

lines.en: : We’re best friends, so you can always tell me if something is on your-
lines.zh: : 我们是最好的朋友，所以有什么心事你都可以跟我说——

lines.en: : I’ll see you later.
lines.zh: : 回头见。

lines.en: : Goodbye, Ami.
lines.zh: : 再见，Ami。

lines.en: scene newrecall8
Maya takes off down the road (The road {i}opposite{/i} from the one that leads to the dorms, mind you) and vanishes from our sight, leaving the two of us equally confused.
lines.zh: Maya 沿着路跑掉了（顺便说一句，是跟回宿舍那条路{i}相反{/i}的方向），转眼消失在我们的视线里，留下我们两个同样一头雾水。

lines.en: I can tell that Ami is worried, but I chalk this sudden disappearance up to just another one of Maya's mood swings. I highly doubt it's anything substantial.
lines.zh: 我看得出 Ami 很担心，但我把这次突然消失归结为 Maya 又一次的情绪波动。我很怀疑这背后真有什么大事。

lines.en: : The heck is with her today? That was totally rude.
lines.zh: : 她今天到底怎么回事？那也太失礼了。

lines.en: : It's probably just that time of the month or something.
lines.zh: : 大概就是「那几天」什么的吧。

lines.en: scene newrecall9
: Sensei, ew! Don't you know it's impolite to say things like that?
lines.zh: : Sensei，恶心！你不知道说这种话很不礼貌吗？

lines.en: : Sorry. I’ve just stopped expecting Maya to ever behave predictably, so I'm not too surprised by her sudden, as you put it, {i}crankiness.{/i}
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我已经不指望 Maya 会有行为可预测的时候了，所以对她这突如其来的——用你的话说——{i}暴躁{/i}，我也不太意外。

lines.en: : Well...I guess she {i}does{/i} randomly start acting different sometimes. Like all those random speeches about the universe and stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她{i}确实{/i}有时候会突然变得不太一样。比如那些莫名其妙的关于宇宙的演讲什么的。

lines.en: : You get to hear those too? I thought I was a special case.
lines.zh: : 你也听得到那些？我还以为我是特例呢。

lines.en: : Not so much anymore. She stopped saying that kind of stuff to me when I told her I didn’t really care about or understand any of it.
lines.zh: : 最近不怎么听了。我跟她说我既不关心也听不懂之后，她就不跟我说那些了。

lines.en: : I used to get it all the time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过以前我可是天天听。

lines.en: scene newrecall10
: But anyway! Is it okay with {i}you{/i} if we stop at the store on the way home?
lines.zh: : 总之！我们回家路上能顺便去趟店里吗？

lines.en: : If I take like ten more steps into this hateful summer heat without a drink I am going to melt.
lines.zh: : 要是再在这讨厌的暑气里走十步还喝不上东西，我就要化了。

lines.en: : The store is more than ten steps away, so the chances of you melting on the way there seem pretty high.
lines.zh: : 那家店离这儿可不止十步，所以你在半路上化掉的概率看起来相当高。

lines.en: : Not if you give me a piggyback ride!
lines.zh: : 只要你背我就不会！

lines.en: : Sure. Hop on.
lines.zh: : 好啊。上来吧。

lines.en: scene newrecall11
: Wait...really?
lines.zh: : 等等……真的吗？

lines.en: : Because I was kind of just kidding. I’m fine walking on my own for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 因为我其实只是开玩笑的。再自己走一会儿我也没问题。

lines.en: : You sure? Because I really don't mind.
lines.zh: : 你确定？因为我真的不介意。

lines.en: : You mean you...won't feel embarrassed or anything?
lines.zh: : 你是说你……不会觉得难为情什么的？

lines.en: : Embarrassed? Not really. I'll probably feel like an idiot, but I've also noticed how flushed you've been since we stepped outside.
lines.zh: : 难为情？倒不至于。我多半会觉得自己像个傻子，不过我也注意到了，从我们出门开始你的脸就一直通红。

lines.en: : So if having you on my back is all it takes for you to {i}not{/i} die, that's fine by me.
lines.zh: : 所以只要把你背在背上就{i}不{/i}至于让你死掉，那我无所谓。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s only a couple blocks away. If it was any longer, I doubt I'd have the stamina or the willpower to continue.
lines.zh: : 再说了，也就几个街区而已。要是再远一点，我怀疑自己既没体力也没毅力坚持下去了。

lines.en: : Well...thanks, [amimaster]. I-
lines.zh: : 那个……谢谢，[amimaster]。我——

lines.en: scene newrecall12
: Hey! Wait a second! What do you mean {i}stamina or willpower?!{/i} Are you calling me fat?!
lines.zh: : 嘿！等一下！你说{i}体力和毅力{/i}是什么意思？！你是在说我胖吗？！

lines.en: : Just get on my back, Ami.
lines.zh: : 快上来吧，Ami。

lines.en: : Fine! But if you complain even once about me being heavy, I’m pulling your hair out!
lines.zh: : 好吧！不过你要是敢抱怨一句我重，我就把你的头发拔光！

lines.en: scene black
Ami hops onto my back and throws her arms around my neck.
lines.zh: Ami 跳到我背上，双臂环住我的脖子。

lines.en: Of course, she isn’t heavy at all. It's like carrying a large backpack if the backpack cooked you dinner and occasionally said mildly suggestive things about your relationship.
lines.zh: 当然，她一点都不重。感觉就像背着一个大背包——如果这个背包会给你做晚饭，偶尔还会说几句关于你们关系的、稍微有点暗示意味的话的话。

lines.en: We get some strange looks from people as we make our way down the street, but neither of us seem to really care.
lines.zh: 我们沿街走的时候收到了一些异样的目光，但我俩似乎都不怎么在意。

lines.en: In fact, Ami seems quite happy about not having to walk anymore.
lines.zh: 事实上，Ami 对不用再走路这件事似乎相当开心。

lines.en: Her fingers grab hold of the collar of my shirt and cause my tie to get messed up, but she takes a moment to playfully tuck it back in as we round the corner and wind up in front of the shop...
lines.zh: 她的手指揪住我的衬衫领子，把我的领带弄乱了，不过在我们拐过弯、停在店门口时，她还俏皮地花了点时间帮我把它塞了回去……

lines.en: scene amicon1
: Thanks for the ride, [amimaster]! And thanks for buying me a drink as well!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你背我，[amimaster]！也谢谢你给我买饮料！

lines.en: : Well it’s not like you had any money, so...
lines.zh: : 反正你又没带钱，所以……

lines.en: scene amicon2
: Heheh...silly me, forgetting my wallet and asking you to pay for me. Good thing I have the best [uncle] in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我真傻，忘了带钱包还让你付钱。幸好我有全世界最好的[uncle]。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Flattery won’t get you anywhere.
lines.zh: : 是是是。拍马屁可换不来什么。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
scene amicon3
: Really? Cause I could have sworn that all of that ‘flattery’ was one of the things helping get you into my dorm room at night.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我明明记得，正是那些「马屁」帮你进了我的宿舍房间，还是在晚上。

lines.en: : You really want to talk about our relationship in front of a convenience store in the middle of the day?
lines.zh: : 你真想在大白天、在便利店门口聊我们之间的关系？

lines.en: : What's wrong? No one here knows we’re related.
lines.zh: : 有什么关系？这儿又没人知道我们是亲戚。

lines.en: : I think you might also be forgetting the issue with our age gap as well.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能还忘了一件事——我们的年龄差。

lines.en: scene amicon2
: Pfft...whatever. I'll save the flirting for until we're home.
lines.zh: : 切……随便啦。那我就把调情留到回家以后。

lines.en: else:
scene amicon3
: Awww, why not? I was hoping I’d {i}at least{/i} get a raise on my allowance or something.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，为什么不行？我还指望{i}至少{/i}能涨点零花钱什么的呢。

lines.en: : You don’t even get an allowance, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你根本就没有零花钱，Ami。

lines.en: scene amicon2
: Well I {i}did{/i} until you decided you just weren't going to give me one anymore.
lines.zh: : {i}以前有{/i}啊，直到你决定不再给我为止。

lines.en: : I put a roof over your head. Isn't that enough?
lines.zh: : 我给你提供了住的地方。这还不够吗？

lines.en: : Not really, but I guess it's not up to me to decide what you do with your money.
lines.zh: : 不太够，不过我想你怎么花钱也轮不到我来决定。

lines.en: scene amicon4
: Oh! So, I had a question about this test thingy I totally forgot to ask you.
lines.zh: : 哦！对了，关于那个考试什么的，我有个问题完全忘了问你。

lines.en: : This again? I thought we were finally done talking about that.
lines.zh: : 又来了？我还以为我们终于聊完那个了。

lines.en: : Nononono, this one isn’t about studying or anything like that. I was just wondering what you planned on doing {i}after{/i} the tests.
lines.zh: : 不不不，这次不是关于学习什么的。我只是想知道考试结束{i}之后{/i}你打算做什么。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that as soon as those are over, we start the last semester of the[school] year.
lines.zh: : 我是说，那些一结束，我们就要开始这[school]年的最后一个学期了。

lines.en: : Which means that a few months later, summer vacation starts.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，再过几个月，暑假就开始了。

lines.en: scene amicon5
: Which means that...
lines.zh: : 也就是说……

lines.en: : You won’t be my teacher for much longer...
lines.zh: : 你当我的老师的时间不多了……

lines.en: Is the end of the year really that close?
lines.zh: 学年结束真的已经这么近了吗？

lines.en: I remember talking about it with Sana recently, but...I didn’t think it would get here {i}this{/i} quickly.
lines.zh: 我记得最近还跟 Sana 聊过这件事，不过……我没想到它会来得{i}这么{/i}快。

lines.en: Maybe I {i}should{/i} talk to one of the staff members and see about carrying my class over into the next year?
lines.zh: 也许我{i}该{/i}跟哪位教职员谈谈，看看能不能把我的班带到下一学年？

lines.en: It would be a shame having to start all over after coming so far with so many of them.
lines.zh: 和她们这么多人走到这一步，却要一切从头开始，未免太可惜了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry just yet, Ami. There’s still...some semblance of hope that I’ll be able to teach you again next year.
lines.zh: : 先别担心，Ami。还是……有那么一线希望，我明年还能继续教你们的。

lines.en: scene amicon4
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 咦？什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that I can try to talk to someone about just...keeping the same class?
lines.zh: : 我是说我可以试着跟谁谈谈……就，继续带同一个班？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I haven’t figured it out yet.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我还没想好。

lines.en: scene amicon5
: That somehow makes me feel even {i}less{/i} confident about you teaching me again...
lines.zh: : 不知怎么的，这让我对你还能教我这件事{i}更没{/i}信心了……

lines.en: : You at least need a {i}plan,{/i} Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你至少得有个{i}计划{/i}啊，Sensei……

lines.en: scene amicon4
: Oh! What if you, like...go up to the principal and start crying or something?
lines.zh: : 哦！要是你……比如说，跑去校长面前哭一场什么的呢？

lines.en: : Remember how I always used to cry when you wouldn’t buy me anything from the convenience store?
lines.zh: : 还记得以前你不肯在便利店给我买东西时，我总是怎么哭的吗？

lines.en: : You mean like what happened two minutes ago?...
lines.zh: : 你是说就像两分钟前发生的那样？……

lines.en: scene amicon6
: Ahh...I remember it like it was yesterday.
lines.zh: : 啊……我记忆犹新，就像昨天发生的一样。

lines.en: : Again, it was two minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，那是两分钟前的事。

lines.en: scene amicon1
: Maybe if you try that with the principal, he’ll let you teach us all again!
lines.zh: : 也许你要是对校长来这一手，他就会让你再教我们所有人啦！

lines.en: : I can’t imagine that working, to be honest. There comes a time in your life where crying just doesn’t always get you what you want anymore.
lines.zh: : 说实话我想象不出那会有用。人生总有那么一个阶段，哭不再总能让你得到想要的东西。

lines.en: scene amicon2
: Really? Cause I’m getting older and it’s clearly still working for me.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可我越长越大了，这招对我显然还是管用啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, well you’re cute. The world works differently for cute girls.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你长得可爱。这个世界对可爱女孩的运行规则不一样。

lines.en: : You can pretty much cry your entire way through life and everything will work out.
lines.zh: : 你基本可以一路哭着走完人生，什么都会顺顺利利的。

lines.en: scene amicon7
: Ah! Am I...experiencing sexism for the first time? Is that what this is?
lines.zh: : 啊！我这是……第一次遭遇性别歧视吗？这就是那种感觉吗？

lines.en: : Is this a taste of the world yet to come?
lines.zh: : 这就是未来那个世界给我的预演吗？

lines.en: : I don’t like this at all, Sensei! I feel strange! Please, hold me and make me feel better!
lines.zh: : 我一点都不喜欢这样，Sensei！我感觉怪怪的！求你了，抱抱我让我好受点！

lines.en: : I’m not going to hold you with all of these people around.
lines.zh: : 这么多人围着，我可不抱你。

lines.en: scene amicon8
: That’s no fair! You already gave me a piggyback ride! How is a little hug any different?!
lines.zh: : 不公平！你都背我了！抱一下又有什么不一样？！

lines.en: : It just is, okay? Besides, you’re not even upset right now.
lines.zh: : 就是不一样，行了吧？再说了，你现在根本就不难过。

lines.en: : How do you know that?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道？！

lines.en: : Because you never get angry-eyebrows when you’re upset. You always go into puppydog-mode.
lines.zh: : 因为你难过的时候从来不会露出生气眉。你总是切换成小狗模式。

lines.en: : Puppies can get angry!
lines.zh: : 小狗也是会生气的！

lines.en: : So you’re a literal puppy now?
lines.zh: : 所以你现在是字面意义上的小狗了？

lines.en: : Yes! Woof~!
scene amicon5
: Can you at least hold my hand?
lines.zh: : 那你至少牵我的手总行吧？

lines.en: : Ugh, fine.
lines.zh: : 唉，行吧。

lines.en: scene amicon6
: Yay!
: When we get home.
lines.zh: : 等回家再说。

lines.en: scene amicon9
: GAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : Wow. You must really like holding hands.
lines.zh: : 哇。你一定很喜欢牵手。

lines.en: scene amicon8
: No! I really like {i}you{/i}! Get the hint already!
lines.zh: : 不是！我是真的喜欢{i}你{/i}！你倒是快点明白啊！

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
Of course I have obviously {i}gotten the hint{/i}. It's kind of hard not to after bringing your niece to orgasm.
lines.zh: 我当然早就{i}明白{/i}了。毕竟都把你侄女送上高潮了，想不明白也难。

lines.en: But there’s a time and a place for everything. And I don’t think the two of us are at the point where we should be expressing those feelings in public just yet...
lines.zh: 不过凡事都有时间和场合。我觉得我们俩还没到可以在公共场合表达那种感情的地步……

lines.en: And honestly, I doubt a time where that will be acceptable will ever come.
lines.zh: 说实话，我怀疑那一天永远不会到来。

lines.en: else:
Of course I know how Ami feels about me...but I’m supposed to be her [uncle] now.
lines.zh: 我当然知道 Ami 对我是什么感情……可我现在应该是她的[uncle]。

lines.en: It just wouldn't be right to use that position to take advantage of her. And it {i}especially{/i} would not be right in public.
lines.zh: 利用这个身份去占她便宜就是不对。在公共场合就{i}更{/i}不对了。

lines.en: : Can we just get back to the topic at hand?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能回到正题上？

lines.en: : You asked me what my plans were after the next batch of tests were over, but what about yours?
lines.zh: : 你问我下一轮考试结束之后有什么打算，那你自己的呢？

lines.en: scene amicon4
: Mine? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 我的？什么意思？

lines.en: : Well...how are you going to spend your last couple months in[school]?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你在[school]的最后几个月打算怎么过？

lines.en: scene amicon1
: Umm...The same way I have been, I guess?
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概跟以前一样吧？

lines.en: : I’ve been trying not to think about it, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我一直在努力不去想这件事。

lines.en: : I already have a problem with getting attached to stuff, so if I dwell on this[school] year ending, I’ll just wind up feeling even worse once it’s actually over.
lines.zh: : 我本来就很容易对东西产生依恋，所以要是老是想着这[school]年要结束，等它真的结束时我只会更难受。

lines.en: scene amicon10
: We’re so close to the end at this point and...there isn’t really anything we can do about it.
lines.zh: : 事到如今我们已经这么接近尾声了，而且……我们也真的无能为力。

lines.en: : I’ve accepted that.
lines.zh: : 我已经接受了。

lines.en: : It might sound kinda sad, but...that’s just life, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 听起来可能有点伤感，不过……生活本来就是这样，不是吗？

lines.en: scene amicon11
: You always told me when I was little that time won’t ever wait for us.
lines.zh: : 我小时候你总跟我说，时间永远不会等我们。

lines.en: : And that even if I sit down and wish as hard as I can, over and over...there’s no guarantee that any of those wishes will ever come true.
lines.zh: : 还说就算我坐下来一遍又一遍地拼命许愿……也不能保证其中任何一个会成真。

lines.en: : So...ever since then, I’ve just taken things day by day. And it’s worked out so far!
lines.zh: : 所以……从那以后，我就只是一天一天地过。到目前为止都还挺顺利的！

lines.en: : I mean, the two of us are closer than ever. That’s gotta be a plus, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我们俩比以往任何时候都更亲密了。这总该算个好事吧？

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: scene amicon12
: Um...sorry for getting sappy out of nowhere like that. I think this coffee’s got espresso in it or something because my brain’s moving at like, twice the speed it normally does.
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉突然这么煽情。我觉得这咖啡里大概加了浓缩什么的，因为我的脑子现在转得有平时的两倍快。

lines.en: : Would you mind giving me another piggyback ride on the way home by any chance? If I can't keep up with my own thoughts, I doubt I'll be able to keep up with...my legs. Or something.
lines.zh: : 回家的路上你介意再背我一次吗？要是我的脑子都跟不上了，我怀疑我也跟不上的……就是我的腿。大概吧。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I think...walking might be kinda bad for my over-caffeinated [teenage]heart right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……现在走路对我这颗咖啡因过量的[teenage]心脏可能不太好。

lines.en: : That's an excuse if I've ever heard one. You're walking and that's that. Your piggyback quota for the day has already been exceeded, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 这绝对是我听过最烂的借口。你就走着吧，就这么定了。很遗憾，你今天的背人配额已经超了。

lines.en: scene amicon5
: Hah...I had a feeling you were going to say something like that...
lines.zh: : 哈……我就知道你会这么说……

lines.en: scene black
Ami and I begin the short voyage to the bus station, this time walking several feet apart from one another.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 开始了前往公交车站的短途旅程，这一次我们之间隔着好几英尺的距离。

lines.en: She talks more about potential plans for getting me to be her teacher again, but none of them seem all that feasible.
lines.zh: 她又聊了更多让我继续当她老师的可能方案，但没有一个看起来真的可行。

lines.en: I’ll just have to figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我只能另想办法了。

lines.en: I really don't want to start all over.
lines.zh: 我真的不想一切从头开始。

$ day96 = True
{i}Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!{/i}
